From the served 128k trace (ticksweep's B128: 651 requests over 1,486 s, 51 of them hits, every hit block 60-300 s after the request that computed it, 189 s on average a saved FLOP), the expectation over a uniformly random phase: 31.5% of its hits' 13.86% (16 phases: 33.2%, from 0.4% to 95%). The served 2k traces reuse 3-7 s back (median) and lose 1.0-2.5% of their hits, 0.08-0.22% of their FLOPs
